name: How much does it cost to install kitchen task lighting?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install kitchen task lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of installing kitchen task lighting varies depending on several factors, including the type of fixtures chosen, the complexity of the electrical work, and the size of your kitchen. Simple installations of plug-in LED strips might be a few hundred dollars, while hardwired under-cabinet lighting or recessed lighting requiring new wiring could range from $800 to $2,500 or more per area. Factors like the need for new circuits, patching walls, and the specific lighting products selected will impact the final price. We provide detailed quotes after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation costs vary widely based on fixture type, electrical complexity, and kitchen size, ranging from a few hundred dollars for simple setups to over $2,500 for extensive hardwired systems.
